report.clinical_summary: Patient with chronic HIV infection (6 years) presents with persistent low energy and frequent headaches for ~2 months. Recent viral load showed detectable level (340 copies/mL) after being undetectable 3 months ago. Patient has been missing 2-3 doses per week due to social activities, work stress, and 'drug holidays' when feeling well. Patient has supportive partner who can help with reminders. Patient expresses worry about long-term effects, resistance development, and emotional toll of living with HIV. Patient shows good understanding of treatment mechanism and is ready to get back on track with consistent medication.
